question.prompt: The frequencies of the classes 40 to 50, 50 to 60, 60 to 70, and 70 to 80 are 4, 10, 16, and 10, respectively. What is the estimated mean using the class midpoints?

solutions.explanation: The class midpoints are 45, 55, 65, and 75, respectively, and the total frequency is 40. The mean \(\approx(180+550+1040+750)\div40=2520\div40=63\).
solutions.title: Frequency-weighted midpoint estimate
